outcome.Summary: Fixed six bugs in the INI parser in ini/ini.go to match the documented format: trim each line before dispatch (so `  [Server]` parses and whitespace-only lines are ignored), treat lines starting with `#` as comments, lower-case section names, split on the first `=` (was LastIndex, which broke values containing `=`), preserve inner whitespace of double-quoted values without trimming, strip inline comments only at " ;"/" #" in unquoted values (was any `;`), and make repeated keys in a section overwrite instead of keep-first. Verified with `go test ./...` (exit 0) and `go vet`.
